answer: One concrete mechanism: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because harbor only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, bridge is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any knoll approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
